en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-53 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his uncle Muhammad ibn Abil-Qasim quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Sin’an, on the authority of Abi Hamzih al-Sumaly that Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB) said,
“God will establish a home in Paradise for whoever does the following four things: lodges orphans; is merciful to the weak; is kind to his parents and is kind to his slaves.”
